| description = This undead ape can sometimes be found wandering near the forest Giant fort. While undead, does flee at low health. He drops the mantle almost every time. More than one Gullerback can be up at one time, and can even come within sight of each other.

Be careful pulling him as the variant of him which is level 51 can summon you to him. This NPC is also very resistant to '''magic-based''' spells and songs, and cannot be rooted or snared. Fire-based spells seem to land normally.

10/21/2020 - Killed five consecutive Gullerback spawns while trying to spawn Azdalin. He was level 51 each time.

12/31/20 - Killed one that did not summon, confirming that he spawns with a level range.
